about_the_game:
Fate casts its dice—and I see. I see that you'll take on the role of a girl. Hair like fire, born in a black hut near the graveyard. It's no easy role, and your choices are many: will you be kind and gentle, or wild and willful? Will you serve others, or seek only your own gain? Or maybe you’ll walk a third path… Time will tell. Your fate is yours alone. It depends on you—and your strength.

----

  • A text-based RPG set in a free-form Slavic fantasy world

  • Unlimited freedom of choice – Every decision shapes the story, creating a unique experience

  • Multiple endings – Unlock different outcomes based on your actions

  • An intriguing story – A tale that changes and deepens with each choice

----

Chapter II: Where It All Begins

Step into the girl’s adolescence—with all its fears, discoveries, and first serious choices.

  • Make friends… or earn enemies

  • Save lives… or turn away

  • Make your choice—and bear its consequences

New traits, characters, places, and situations await.

Keep exploring the world—and write your own fate.

  • Processor: 2.0 GHz Dual Core
  • Memory: 2048 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with DirectX 11 support

short_description: A text-based RPG with a nonlinear story set in a free Slavic fantasy world. Shape the heroine's character through your choices and unlock multiple endings. Mystery, folklore, and relationships — your fate depends only on you.
